top_signals.title: Asian LNG Prices Surge Past $30 as Middle East Shipping Risks Escalate
top_signals.summary: Liquefied natural gas prices on the Asian spot market topped $30 per million British thermal units for the first time since December 2022, Bloomberg reported earlier today. The price jump follows a report about a strike on an LNG tanker in the Gulf of Aden, off the Yemeni coast. The UK Maritime Trade Operations outlet reported an LNG carrier coming under attack in the Red Sea, from a small boat, whose crew fired twice at the tanker. The tanker’s crew fired warning shots in return, the UKMTO said on Saturday. The report suggests a return to…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
